0xfffffff007cfc4b4.id: Millisecond spin-delay wrapper: set w1=1000000 ns/ms, then tail-call delay_for_interval. Driver calls it with w0=1000/10/100 ms during initialization and retries.
0xfffffff007cfc4b4.anchor: iOS 12 address 0xfffffff0076b4a5c implements delay_for_interval using timebase constant 0x5a53a09bb82f0044 and cntpct_el0. The iOS 13 symbol _delay_for_interval is at 0xfffffff0070efbc8 with two additional leading instructions.
0xfffffff007cfc4b4.reason: iOS 13 inlines the single-argument wrapper. The driver supplies only w0; delay_for_interval needs interval and scale, so scale=1000000 must be supplied.
0xfffffff007cfc4b4.resolution: Append three instructions and map 0xfffffff007cfc4b4 to them: movz w1,#0x4240; movk w1,#0xf,lsl16; b 0xfffffff0070efbc8. The approximately 18 MB branch is within the +/-128 MB range and preserves the millisecond spin delay.
